provenance.freshness_rule: fresh = a non-retained message within max_age; retained = only the broker's replayed copy is held for this value; stale = live but older; unavailable = never seen. Freshness belongs to the payload it arrived with: a retained copy with a different payload replaces the value as retained.

producer_time.disciplined_reason: not observed by the daemon; check chronyc on the sensor

input.units_note: unitless receiver level, not dBm; dB values are 10*log10 of power ratios
input.bin0_note: float 0 is the fastlock/sweep step word replacing the -fs/2 edge bin

config.bound_reason: RX settings come from retained state/rx/* topics polled by api_controller.sh; the /waterfall frame carries no configuration tag, so a frame near a retune may describe the previous settings

sweep.note: sweep/DDC frames are not interpreted by this daemon; when engaged, span and hz_per_bin describe one step, not the sweep

gates.scope: gates describe the matched window of this frame, not the emitter

features.scope: residual = live power minus learned receiver baseline, spur bins masked
features.units: bandwidth_frac: fraction of bins_used at -10 dB; spectral_papr_db: peak bin power over mean bin power in dB (a spectral ratio, NOT time-domain IQ PAPR); flatness: geometric/arithmetic mean of power (0..1); peak_count: local maxima within -15 dB of the peak

frequency_view.note: Two different things, deliberately kept apart. matched_window is the frequency range of the template window the daemon scored and accepted (decision.bin_offset / bandwidth_bins): the matched emission, in the daemon's own words. whole_span_peak is where the strongest bin of the residual (spectrum over the learned background) sits across the ENTIRE span (features.peak_bin), whatever it is. They need not coincide: the window can match a weaker emission while the span's strongest bin belongs to something else, and the window is only reported on an accepted match. peak_inside_matched_window false does not by itself mean the window is wrong: the strongest residual bin need not be the strongest emission (it can be a change since the background was learned). Neither value is a scoring input; both are presentation derived from the observation with the grid rule.
frequency_view.grid_rule: usable bin j centred at center_hz + (j + 1 - fft_size/2) * span_hz / fft_size; bin0_offset hides the step word

matched_window.label: FM Broadcast
matched_window.meaning: frequency range of the template window the daemon scored and accepted

whole_span_peak.meaning: centre of the strongest residual bin (spectrum over the learned background) over the whole span (features.peak_bin); independent of any match

temporal.occupancy_note: sampled heuristic: share of the last cycles (about 1/s) whose residual PAPR exceeded 14 dB; not a measured duty cycle
